utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, the book club? I heard they’re picking the next read soon—want me to keep an ear out for the details?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Yes, please keep me posted—are they deciding this week?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yep, that’s what I heard—this week or early next, so I’ll let you know as soon as I hear anything.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — I’ll bring it up at the book club and see what everyone thinks.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — thanks, Vik. Let me know what they say at book club.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Will do — I’ll ask them at book club and let you know.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good—what time’s the book club meeting?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: It starts at 7 tonight over at my place.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great, I’ll be there at 7.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I haven’t heard much about the book club yet, but I’d be glad to learn what it’s like.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: It’s pretty relaxed—mostly a few neighbors chatting about whatever we’re reading. You should come by sometime; I can let you know when we meet next.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That sounds nice—I'd like that. Just let me know when the next meeting is.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That sounds lovely — what time is the book club meeting this week?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I think it starts at 7 this week, but I’ll double-check so I don’t send you the wrong time.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, I appreciate that — just let me know when you confirm.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’d like to keep it simple—what day and time are we meeting for book club?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right—good question. I think we said Thursday evening, around 7?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thursday at 7 works for me—let’s keep it there.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, absolutely — I’d love to share the book club invite around and see who wants to join.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That sounds good, just please make sure the details are clear so nobody gets confused about the time or place.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Definitely — I’ll include the time, place, and any extra details so it’s crystal clear.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh hey Rosa, I heard the book club’s meeting soon — is that right? I’m still catching up, so I’d love the details.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Yes, that’s right — we’re meeting this Thursday evening at the community room. I’ll send you the book title and time, and you’re very welcome to join us.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Rosa — I’d really appreciate that. I’m looking forward to joining if I can make it.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you remind me of the book club details before I say yes?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Of course — I just need to check the date, time, and where we’re meeting before I tell you for sure.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Mara — just let me know once you’ve confirmed the date, time, and place.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I might sit this one out tonight, Dane. If you save me a seat, I’d appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sure thing — I’ll save you a seat by me.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Dane. I’ll let you know if I make it.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — if the book club needs any extra chairs, a projector, or even just a hand setting up, I’ve got you.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Gus — could you bring the projector and maybe four extra chairs?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Absolutely — I’ll bring the projector and four extra chairs.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I haven’t heard where the book club is meeting yet—do you know the location?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I’m not sure yet—I probably missed the update. Want me to check with the group?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Yes, please do—if you find out, let me know the address.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — if the book club needs any supplies or a spare table, I’ve got you covered.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Gus — that’s really kind of you. I’ll keep that in mind for the next meeting.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Of course — just let me know what you need for the next meeting, and I’ll bring it by.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m happy to help, but I’d want to know the time and where we’re meeting first.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Right — can you confirm the time and the place, Pia?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can, if you send me the time and the place first — then I’ll know whether I can make it.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m happy to help bring everyone together for the book club—what are you thinking of planning?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That’s lovely, Jules—could we plan a relaxed first meetup with a short book chat and some snacks? I’d love to keep it simple and welcoming for everyone.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — a relaxed first meetup sounds perfect. I can help pick an easy book chat prompt and keep the snacks simple and welcoming.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can check what we’ve got for the book club and see if we need anything else.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, that’d be great — I’ll probably end up joining a bit late again.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: No worries, I’ll keep an eye on the supplies and let you know if we’re missing anything.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the book club is meeting later this week — I’m hoping they picked something good!

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I hope so too — I’ll need to work around the kids’ school pickup if I’m going to make it.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, that’ll be tricky — maybe they’ll choose a time that works for everyone. I’ll let you know if I hear any details!

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, book club? Sounds good—what’s the plan?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: I’m thinking we meet next Thursday at 7, keep it cozy, and start with a short discussion before snacks. Does that work for you?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, that works for me. Next Thursday at 7 sounds easy enough.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’d be happy to help with the book club—what do you need?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Sam — could you help pick this month’s book and maybe send a quick reminder to the group?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I can help pick a book and send a quick reminder. Any genre or reading length you want this month?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, the book club? I’d love to invite a few people and see if we can make it a lively one.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That sounds great—I’d be happy to pass it along if you want.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Wonderful, thanks—please do! I’ll round up a few neighbors and get the word out.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I can keep track of where everyone is for book club—just tell me the time and place, and I’ll note it down.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Opal. Let’s say Thursday at 7 at my place, and I’ll have the tea ready.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Perfect—I’ve got Thursday at 7 at your place, and tea is covered. I’ll note it down.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hey Hana, are we still on for book club this week?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Yes, I think so — what day and time did we settle on?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I think we said Thursday at 7. Does that still work for you?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, I heard the book club’s meeting got moved this week. Did you want to go together?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, yes please — I’d like that. I keep forgetting the new day, so going together would help.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sure thing — I’ll swing by and we can head over together. I’ll remind you of the new day when I see you.
